bibliographic-data.invention-title: BLUTFÄRBEPFLASTER UND VERFAHREN UND VORRICHTUNG ZUM TESTEN VON BLUT DAMIT
PATCH DE COLORATION DU SANG, ET PROCÉDÉ ET APPAREIL POUR ANALYSER LE SANG L'UTILISANT
BLOOD STAINING PATCH, AND METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR TESTING BLOOD USING SAME

abstract.p: The present disclosure relates to a blood test device, which is a blood test device using a patch, which includes a mesh structural body forming micro-cavities and is configured to contain a staining reagent for staining staining targets present in blood in the micro-cavities, to perform a blood test through staining of the staining target, the blood test device comprising:a plate supporter configured to support a plate on which a reaction region is placed and blood is placed in the reaction region;a patch controller configured to use the patch, which is configured to contain the staining reagent, and control a relative position of the patch relative to the reaction region so that the staining reagent is provided to the reaction region; anda reaction detector configured to detect a result of staining of the staining target present in the blood to examine the blood.
